resources.string: Watches for full-screen ads in other apps and closes them for you: it presses Skip as soon as the countdown allows, and finds and taps the real close (X) button while avoiding fake ones.

How it works:

• When an ad appears in another app, Ad Closer scans the screen.

• If the ad has a countdown that can’t be shortened, it waits and taps the close button the moment it appears.

• If a “Skip” button becomes available early, it presses it right away to cut the ad short.

• It looks for the real X — small, in a corner, labelled close/dismiss — and ignores fake X buttons that would open the ad (Install, Learn more, Shop now…).

To activate: turn on the switch above, then enable “Ad Closer” in Accessibility Settings.
